```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(googlesheets4)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
fluor<- as.data.frame(read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/159QQWbnsSv8EMKSw7MRolT06qdi9TPAlmggsCe00o0Q/edit?usp=sharing"))
```

```{r}
fluor$CultureRnd <- as.character(fluor$CultureRnd)

fluor %>% ggplot(aes(x=TimePt, y= Fluor)) + geom_point(aes(color = CultureRnd))  +facet_wrap(~Species+Incubator, scales = "free_y") + theme_bw() + scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma())
```


```{r, warning = FALSE}
pal_C <- c("#EF476F", "#118AB2", "#06D6A0", "#FFB703", "#073B4C", "#8338EC")

Thal<- fluor %>% filter(Species %in% c("Thalassiosira_psuedonana" )) %>%  ggplot(aes(x=TimePt, y= Fluor)) +  geom_point(aes(color = CultureRnd), size = 1, alpha = 0.5)+ geom_smooth(aes(color = CultureRnd), se=FALSE, linewidth = 0.5)  +facet_grid(Incubator~Media, scales = "free_y") + theme_bw() + scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma())  + scale_color_manual(values = pal_C) + ggtitle("Thalassiosira psuedonana")

Thal
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
Tis <- fluor %>% filter(Species %in% c("Tisochrysis"  )) %>%  ggplot(aes(x=TimePt, y= Fluor))  +  geom_point(aes(color = CultureRnd), size = 1, alpha = 0.5)+ geom_smooth(aes(color = CultureRnd), se=FALSE, linewidth = 0.5)  +facet_grid(Incubator~Media, scales = "free_y") + theme_bw() + scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma())  + scale_color_manual(values = pal_C) + ggtitle("Tisochrysis")

Tis
```
